title: Drivefin
description: The films and series of your own Jellyfin server on the centre screen: continue watching, recently added, every library's posters, seasons and episodes, search, and a full-screen player with a progress bar you can drag. Type your server's address once and sign in with Quick Connect, a code you enter in a Jellyfin you are already signed in to: no password is typed in the car, and the sign-in stays on this car's head unit, never in the app. The picture shows while parked (a setting, with a disclaimer to accept, lets a passenger watch while driving); the sound plays on the car's speakers; the steering wheel's skip moves through the film. An unofficial client, not affiliated with the Jellyfin project. Needs the Drivefin service and a GPU renderer from the Store.
